source.title: Kinematic Analysis of Continuum Robot Consisted of Driven Flexible Rods

accepted.question_text: How can positioning-error compensation methods be designed for continuum robots consisting of driven flexible rods so that the robot's positioning accuracy improves?

evidence.quote: Kinematic Analysis of Continuum Robot Consisted of Driven Flexible Rods
We will study the positioning error compensation method in future research to improve the accuracy.
